name: YEXIO Bad Lippspringe data center
developer: HOCHTIEF Data Center Partner / YEXIO Bad Lippspringe GmbH & Co. KG / Palladio Partners; operated by Yorizon
notes: HOCHTIEF announced construction start in Bad Lippspringe, district of Paderborn; completion scheduled for summer 2026. Initial IT capacity is 2 MW, scalable to 4 MW, with direct water cooling and waste heat reuse plans.

name: VegaSystems Paderborn data center
notes: Operator states it runs a Paderborn data center for colocation/server housing with PUE 1.08, 100% green electricity, multi-carrier connectivity, and Paderborn/Bielefeld German data center locations.

name: GKD Recklinghausen municipal data center
notes: GKD Recklinghausen announced its data center was re-certified by TUV TSI; first certified in 2013 and re-certified every two years. Serves the Kreis Recklinghausen municipal IT environment.

name: rgi Remscheid data center
developer: RS Gesellschaft fuer Informationstechnik mbH & Co. KG
notes: rgi offers server housing/colocation from its ISO 27001-certified data center at Auf dem Knapp 35, 42855 Remscheid. The operator lists more than 300 sqm of data center space, redundant cooling, UPS, diesel backup, redundant gigabit routes, and 19-inch rack housing.

name: Microsoft Bedburg BEB61 hyperscale data center
notes: Bedburg reported a symbolic handover of the building permit and upcoming construction for Microsoft's planned data center on about 18 ha in the BEB61 business park. Part of Microsoft's EUR 3.2B German AI/cloud infrastructure investment.

name: Microsoft Bergheim INKA:terra nova hyperscale data center
notes: The March 2026 groundbreaking took place on the future Microsoft site in Bergheim. Earlier municipal announcement identified one of two initial Rheinisches Revier data centers at INKA:terra nova in Bergheim.

name: Microsoft Elsdorf-Heppendorf hyperscale data center
notes: Elsdorf announced agreement to sell two strategic plots for a roughly 26 ha Microsoft hyperscale data center site about 1 km south of Heppendorf; Bedburg's 2026 release confirms Elsdorf as one of the three Rheinisches Revier Microsoft locations.

name: RZF Kaarst - NRW Finance Administration data center
notes: NRW Finance Administration states it is building a new modern RZF data center in Kaarst, Rhein-Kreis Neuss, with about 37,000 sqm of building area. Groundbreaking was in October 2023 and the move from Dusseldorf is planned for 2026.

name: Microsoft Grevenbroich data center
notes: Microsoft announced an additional Rheinisches Revier data center site in Grevenbroich and said it had signed a conditional land purchase agreement. The project depends on a development plan to be prepared with the city.

name: Kreisstadt Siegburg outdoor data center
notes: Data Center Group's DC Mag reference describes an outdoor/container data center implemented for Kreisstadt Siegburg on the fire and rescue station site, completed in about six months and maintained by Data Center Group.

name: Bergisch Gladbach school administration data center
notes: Municipal council document 0640/2023 is a decision proposal for purchasing active network components for the newly established data center of Bergisch Gladbach's IT school administration. Small public-sector IT facility; exact commissioning date and capacity not published in the accessible record.

name: Dinfra Siegen colocation/SaaS data center
developer: Dinfra (Effexx ITS / Uponu GmbH / DeRZ GmbH)
notes: DataCenter-Insider reported Dinfra was building a combined SaaS and colocation data center in Siegen with 100 Gbit/s DE-CIX connectivity, 120-rack capacity, dual grid feeds in the IHW industrial park, planned Tier III/EN 50600 certification, and planned operation within months. Current operational status not independently confirmed from a primary source.

name: Blackstone/QTS Lippetal Rechenzentrum Campus
developer: Blackstone / Quality Technology Services (QTS) / Industriegebiet Westfalen GmbH
notes: Lippetal and Hamm's Industriegebiet Westfalen GmbH signed a conditional purchase agreement with Blackstone, working with QTS, to develop a data center campus in Lippetal. Later Lippetal planning notice says the investor estimates up to EUR 4B investment, public participation ran 2026-06-17 to 2026-07-17 for FNP amendment 54 and Bebauungsplan Nr. 19.
